text: {"label": "Verbal Behavior and Emergent Intraverbals in Autism","definition": "Teaching and assessing verbal operants with autistic children, especially intraverbals, and studying how listener, tact, and multiple-exemplar training produce emergent or derived verbal responses and vocalizations.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on Skinnerian verbal operants and emergent intraverbal relations, not speech-generating device communication, reinforcement schedules and repetitive behavior, or broader social skills teaching."}
